query:
SELECT 
  op.productName,
  op.sku,
  op.color,
  SUM(op.quantity) as totalQty
FROM orderProducts op
JOIN orders o ON op.orderId = o.id
WHERE o.orderNumber IN ('26EGB0354','26EGB0287','26EGB0282','26EGB0266','26EGB0219','26EGB0196','26EGB0170','26EGB0094')
  AND (op.sku LIKE '%UP9%' OR op.sku LIKE '%UP911%' OR op.productName LIKE '%UPANG%' OR op.productName LIKE '%UP9%')
  AND op.isGift = 'no'
GROUP BY op.productName, op.sku, op.color
ORDER BY totalQty DESC;
